item.title: Coldcard hardware wallet firmware bug dating to 2021 has drained $89M from 1,000+ Bitcoin addresses over five days.
U.S. Senate shelves the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act before August recess, leaving crypto market structure legislation in limbo.
SEC pauses Nasdaq bitcoin options approval to review CME Group jurisdictional challenge claiming the product falls under the CFTC.
BlackRock, Fidelity, and other Wall Street firms publicly back the Clarity Act ahead of Senate vote attempts.
SEC Chair Atkins says the agency will proceed with its own crypto rulemaking if the Clarity Act fails to pass Congress in 2026.
Morgan Stanley launches Ether and Solana exchange-traded products with staking at a 0.14% expense ratio.
Morgan Stanley receives conditional OCC approval to charter a national trust bank for digital asset custody and staking.
Citigroup is structuring institutional bitcoin custody to integrate BTC with Treasuries and foreign bonds in a single safekeeping account.
BNY Mellon lets institutions mint and hold USDC directly through the bank under an expanded partnership with Circle.
Minnesota enacts a law authorizing state-chartered banks and credit unions to offer regulated crypto custody services starting August 1.
UK FCA sets stablecoin issuer capital reserves at 1% of circulation, undercutting the EU's 2% MiCA standard.
EU opens MiCA 2.0 consultation to update its crypto framework after the transitional grandfathering period ended July 1.
SEC and CFTC open a joint public consultation on aligning portfolio margin rules across securities and derivatives markets.
U.S. and UK regulators jointly recommend aligning stablecoin issuance and tokenization rules across both jurisdictions.
Bullish sets IPO valuation target at $4.8B in an updated filing, citing growth in institutional digital asset demand.
